text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Hanoi to supply Iraq with rice for years to come.
- Arab economics ministers welcome Iraq's oil deal with U.N.
- Sanctions committee approves a Turkish company offer to supply Iraq with spare parts needed for Iraq's pipeline via Turkey.
- Measures for the export of Iraqi oil will be ready within 24 hours.
- Head of the French oil giant Total Sa says his company signed deals to develop oilfields in southern Iraq.
- Iraqi terminals ready to receive supertankers.
- Delegation from the French Elf Aquitaine and Japanese Mitsubishi arrive in Baghdad for oil deals.
- Preparations underway at Jordan's Aqaba port to ferry food supplies to Iraq.
